name: Eiko Oozaru
source:
A mysterious girl that is also looking for the Phantom; 
 the killer had murdered her father long ago.

Despite the offer for help from Kaoru and the gang, 
she refused, saying, "I might not look strong,  
but I don't need you to help. I'll find the man who killed 
the person that loved me the most!"
